name: @bydiorama/ui
description: The consumer CLI for the bydiorama/ui registry: `add` installs items and their registry dependencies directly (the owned channel — no third-party CLI in the path) and locks them as it goes; `lock`/`sync` compute drift between an installed item and its current upstream, distinguishing a consumer's own edits from an unapplied upstream change, and report which ledger entries apply.
